mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPI) rises above 240.0 in the prior month, it signals accelerating inflation that triggers a monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 240.0, or the signal fails to have a statistically significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) and employment (PAYEMS) signals strong consumer demand and labor market health, which drives positive equity returns as the economy expands. The interaction of these two series produces a stronger signal than either alone.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and PAYEMS increasing fails to produce positive returns in > 60% of cases, or the correlation between the joint signal and returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economic regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 triggers negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate profitability and output constraints.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline below 100.0 in a supply-constrained regime fails to produce negative 60-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1000.0 thousand units signals strong consumer demand for residential construction, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to the housing sector's role in the broader economy.
failure_condition: HOUST above 1000.0 fails to produce positive 5-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Federal Reserve may accelerate tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5%, or the signal has a negative Rank IC (i.e., returns are not consistently negative).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% and rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 240.0 signals a monetary policy response to inflation, which typically leads to negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a potential recession.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise above 240.0 fails to produce negative 60-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is negative (i.e., the signal is not predictive).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic regime, a decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals a manufacturing slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline below 100.0 in a late-cycle regime fails to produce negative 20-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
